jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Schellman is a Top 50 CPA firm and a leading provider of attestation and compliance services. Our professional services focus on security and privacy audits, assessments, and certifications. Schellman has become one of the largest cybersecurity assessment firms in the United States without providing any traditional accounting services. We are an accredited multi-framework ISO Certification Body for security, privacy, business continuity, and quality; a globally licensed PCI Qualified Security Assessor and a top provider to clients serving the federal DoD space as a leading FedRAMP 3PAO and the first assessment firm authorized as a CMMC C3PAO. Our specialty and expertise remain in providing best in class Cybersecurity and IT Audits and Attestations. Our culture, approach with clients, and dedication to our values has led us to consistently be a Great Places to Work certified company and rated as a Best Firms to Work For by Accounting Today and a Glassdoor Best Places to Work. We deeply appreciate our employees, as shown by our first core value – People Come First. This is demonstrated in our culture, benefits, and how we handle business. Come see what makes Schellman special!

Job Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for independently owning a portfolio of multiple, interconnected workstreams and ensuring they collectively deliver strategic value to the organization. This role manages interdependencies, risks, and resources across those workstreams, aligning outcomes with business objectives, and serves as the primary point of accountability for program-level status and decision-making. The Program Manager also owns change management planning and execution for assigned initiatives — assessing change impact, building the change management plan, and partnering with stakeholders across the firm to drive adoption. The Program Manager collaborates with stakeholders — including senior and executive leadership — to ensure transparency, governance, and successful execution of initiatives, and provides mentorship to Project Managers and Project Coordinators to help build project management capability across the PMO. This role does not have formal management authority over other Project Managers' workstreams but is expected to guide and mentor less senior team members informally. The Program Manager reports to the Manager of Enterprise PMO.

Essential Functions

Program Management:

Independently own and lead multiple interconnected workstreams or projects that roll up into a broader program, from initiation through close
Manage interdependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation across those workstreams
Facilitate stakeholder engagement and communication across business units, including regular exposure to senior and executive leadership
Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with scope, schedule, and budget across all workstreams
Provide regular reporting and insights to PMO leadership and executives on program-level status, risks, and outcomes
Serve as an informal mentor to Project Managers and Project Coordinators, sharing PMO methodology, tools, and best practices
Ensure compliance with PMO standards and contribute to methodology and process improvements
Champion the advancement of the PMO by bringing forward best practices in project and program management from across the industry
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting that give leadership clear, timely visibility into program and portfolio health
Serve as a subject matter expert in program management tools and platforms, driving effective adoption and use across the PMO

Change Management

Assess the change management needs of each assigned initiative based on audience (directly and indirectly impacted) and the size, scope, and complexity of the planned change
Create a comprehensive change management plan (CMP), consistent with and aligned to the broader Schellman strategy, to include:
Communications needs and activities
Training needs
Ongoing support and documentation needs
Timeline, budget, and measurable success criteria

Partner with stakeholders and functional resources across the firm to execute the change management plan and drive adoption

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong program and portfolio management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, interdependent workstreams
Ability to manage complexity and cross-functional coordination without direct authority over contributing team members
Demonstrated ability to build and execute change management plans, including communications, training, and adoption measurement
Ability to partner cross-functionally across the firm to drive adoption of change initiatives
Skilled in building dashboards and reporting, with strong working expertise in program/project management tools and platforms
Experience managing IT-related projects and demonstrated ability to select and blend project management approaches (waterfall, agile, hybrid) based on workstream needs
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities, including comfort presenting to senior and executive leadership
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced project management staff
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Wrike and JIRA or other project management software

Education, Work Experience And Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent years of directly related experience
7+ years of project/program management experience, including demonstrated experience managing multiple interconnected or large-scale initiatives concurrently
Experience building and leading change management plans (communications, training, adoption) for enterprise initiatives
Experience mentoring or informally guiding other project management staff
Experience working on IT-related projects, applying both waterfall and agile/hybrid delivery approaches
PMP or PgMP certification preferred

Schellman is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and strongly supports diversity in the workplace; therefore, providing equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. Schellman uses E-Verify in our hiring process.

At Schellman, we strive to provide a flexible and balanced environment and therefore offer the opportunity to work remotely, unless otherwise stated in the job requirements. Connecting, collaborating and continuous education are also highly valued and therefore we require some travel annually for our Internal Service Delivery roles, which can include in-person training, team meet-ups, and strategy meetings. Service Delivery team members will also be required to travel based on business and client needs.

jobs.title: Marketing Project Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Brief Description

As a Marketing Project Delivery Manager at Tricel, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering a diverse portfolio of marketing projects, with a particular focus on the connection between marketing and development processes. You will ensure that all marketing initiatives are delivered efficiently, on time, and within budget, while demonstrating a strong understanding of development methodologies and technologies. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong marketing channel expertise, CRM knowledge, and project management skills to deliver best-in-class marketing programmes across the full marketing mix. You will be experienced in online conversion and will actively run optimisation initiatives to ensure benchmark-level performance across all channels. You will act as the owner of all digital project execution related to design and development, continuously improving processes to ensure delivery takes place in a lean and optimised environment. The Project Manager will be responsible for leading a team that supports the department with the setup, installation, and management of marketing technology tools and products. They will work with stakeholders and end users to plan and configure systems, developing solutions that achieve the required objectives. They will oversee the deployment of programmes and systems, coordinating all parties involved to ensure a smooth process with minimal disruption. The successful candidate must be comfortable working in an agency-style environment where resources need to be managed effectively. The Marketing Project Delivery Manager will report directly to the Group Head of Marketing.

Responsibilities

Manage the day-to-day workload of the design and development team, covering activities from minor updates to Tier 1 project rollouts.
Manage the end-to-end delivery of digital projects and associated technology infrastructure, including marketing automation and CRM integration.
Work closely with technical teams to understand development constraints and opportunities, ensuring marketing initiatives are technically feasible.
Take ownership of both your own platforms and the wider digital platform, safeguarding their reputation within the business and across customer groups.
Act as the primary point of contact for counterpart marketing executives, leading future initiative pipeline readiness, resource planning, capacity estimation, and associated budgeting.
Manage dependencies and interfaces between projects, channels, and platforms, as well as risks and issues that may affect team success, ensuring resources are used appropriately, stakeholders are kept informed, and the consequences of actions are clearly understood.
Provide comprehensive reports on project performance, timelines, and budget.
Analyse project outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement in future projects.
Manage marketing standard operating procedures, including creating new SOPs, maintaining and updating existing procedures, and ensuring the marketing team remains aligned with approved SOPs.
Onboard new Tricel Group team members to the CRM and wider marketing technology stack, ensuring they understand the relevant tools, processes, and best-practice ways of working.
Lead cross-disciplinary programmes aimed at improving conversion across all channels used in the marketing mix, with particular emphasis on websites and other digital media.
Lead daily team stand-ups, track risks, and help eliminate blockers.
Build and maintain a motivated delivery team, including third-party development resources, ensuring there is an iterative plan to work towards.
Drive the digital team to work at pace, ensuring the team remains focused on delivery commitments.
Ensure the team collaborates effectively, communicates clearly, and focuses on the highest-priority work.
Coach team members and colleagues, facilitate continuous improvement, and apply the most appropriate agile and lean tools and techniques for the environment.

Candidate Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
3 - 5 years’ experience in project management, with a strong understanding of both marketing and development processes.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
Proficient in project management tools and software; JIRA experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously in an agency-style setup.
Ability to identify opportunities to deliver an excellent customer experience through project delivery.
Knowledge of computer operating systems, hardware, and software.
Strong analytical thinking skills.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent qualification.
Experience in digital marketing or creative project management.
Familiarity with the latest marketing trends and technologies.
Expertise in CRM management; HubSpot experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Experience working in a cross-functional role involving marketing and software development.
Technical understanding of web development concepts.

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about your development and progression. Alongside a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

Excellent development and growth opportunities
A supportive and collaborative culture
A fun and dynamic work environment
Team-oriented atmosphere.
Good work-life balance.
Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
Employee Assistance Programme
Tax-free vouchers to the value of €1,500
Sports and Social Club.
Health and Wellbeing initiatives
Enhanced maternity leave.
Health Insurance Contribution

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. The company began by producing products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP) and expanded its exports and manufacturing facilities across the UK and Europe through a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family continues to lead Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in more than 50 countries. The company serves markets including storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant distribution. Headquartered in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 19 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities, and employs more than 600 people across these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that strengthen its product capabilities and geographical reach. Over the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation, and Sustainability.

How To Apply

If you are interested in applying for this exciting opportunity, please email HR@tricel.ie with your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you. Closing date for applications is 5pm, Monday 24th August 2026.

Tricel is an equal opportunities employer.

The Project Manager must be comfortable operating in an Agile environment and coordinating day-to-day work across teams to support enterprise-scale delivery.

A strong candidate will be able to lead discussions with business and IT leadership, communicate clearly across teams, and manage competing priorities across parallel workstreams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Senior Project Manager (PM) is responsible for planning and coordinating enhancements, integrations, application changes, and operational improvements across clients’ D365 platform, including all supporting applications, data solutions, and reports. This includes sprint execution, release management, stakeholder communication, risk management, and enforcing Endeavor4’s delivery standards across all project workstreams.

Leading all Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.

您将负责领导涉及大语言模型集成、数据智能平台构建或智能体系统开发等前沿技术的项目。
核心挑战在于管理技术探索性带来的高度不确定性，运用适应性规划与假设驱动交付，引领团队在快速试错中收敛于高价值解决方案。
构建数据驱动的智能决策体系
您将建立并利用项目数据仪表板与AI分析工具，实时监控开发效能、质量指标、资源负荷与风险信号。通过预测性分析（如基于历史数据的延期风险预测、价值流瓶颈识别），实现从被动响应到主动干预的管理升级。
设计并运营自适应交付框架
针对AI项目特性（如数据依赖、模型迭代、算力管理），您将为客户量身定制或优化混合交付框架（如敏捷、流式框架与阶段门控的结合）。
您将引入并实践AI辅助的项目管理实践，例如利用自然语言处理自动生成用户故事、通过模拟优化资源调度、或使用智能工具管理技术债务与依赖关系。
管理智能化解决方案的价值闭环
您将确保项目目标与客户的AI战略及业务价值紧密对齐。这包括共同定义合理的成功度量标准（如模型准确率、用户采纳度、业务指标提升），并建立从模型性能监控到业务影响分析的持续反馈循环，证明技术投资的回报。
驾驭技术风险与伦理治理
您将主动识别与管理AI项目特有的风险，如数据质量与偏见、模型安全与合规性、生产环境中的模型漂移等。您将与技术团队紧密协作，确保项目在技术可行性、交付时限与负责任的AI实践之间取得最佳平衡。
赋能团队与生态化协作

您将营造一个心理安全、持续学习的团队环境，特别鼓励在探索性技术工作中进行知识分享与复盘。作为关键枢纽，您将有效整合客户、内部专家及第三方技术供应商，构建高效协同的交付生态。

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Program Manager III within PNC's Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA or Dallas, TX.

We are seeking a highly experienced Program Manager III to support C&IB’s Technology Execution function within the President’s CIO group Business Management organization. This role operates at a strategic and executive level, driving enterprise-wide program visibility and reporting, influencing senior leadership, and ensuring alignment of critical technology initiatives with organizational priorities and target business outcomes.

This role will act a program leader and coach helping shape executive narratives, and deliver high-impact communications for senior leadership and board-level audiences. The ideal candidate combines deep program management expertise with exceptional storytelling, executive presence, and the ability to curate and simplify complex data into clear, actionable insights.

Support end-to-end oversight of complex, multi-workstream strategic technology programs.
Ensure program delivery aligns with enterprise goals, timelines, budgets, and expected business outcomes.
Own development of executive-ready presentations, board materials, and strategic briefings.
Translate complex program data into clear, concise, and compelling narratives for CIOs and board members.
Deliver polished, high-quality decks with strong storytelling, data visualization, and actionable insights.
Promote best practices across planning, governance, risk management, and execution disciplines.
Partner directly with senior leaders and business stakeholders to align priorities and drive decision-making.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on program health, risks, and trade-offs.
Design and deliver enterprise-level program reporting frameworks, dashboards, and KPIs.
Synthesize financials, resource data, and delivery metrics into forward-looking insights and recommendations.
Drive consistency and rigor in program reporting across initiatives.
Oversee budget forecasting, financial tracking, and resource strategy across large-scale programs.
Identify optimization opportunities across cost, capacity, and delivery performance.
Establish and enforce program governance frameworks, standards, and controls.
Champion and enhance Agile Ways of Working (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across large programs and portfolios.
Drive scalability, efficiency, and continuous improvement across delivery teams.

Program/project management experience in technology, operations, or enterprise environments.

Proven ability to create/curate and present executive-level and board-quality materials with strong storytelling and visual clarity.
Experience coaching and mentoring program/project managers and leading through influence.
Advanced expertise planning and managing large-scale, complex programs with multiple dependencies and cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior
Project Manager
to support our multi-disciplinary design team addressing the most challenging engineering tasks in power generation. AECOM's broad technical capabilities, global footprint and experience in executing large scale projects uniquely position us to lead in renewable, traditional steam, thermal power generation and advanced nuclear technologies.

This includes being a part of the first-of-a-kind program with AECOM partners advancing the innovative stellarator technology to the world.

https://aecom.com/press-releases/aecom-establishes-partnership-with-type-one-energy-to-provide-design-engineering-services-for-its-innovative-stellarator-fusion-power-plant-infinity-two/

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

We seek a project professional able to manage the project lifecycle from the project basis of design stage through the issuance of deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination between internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a strong understanding of engineering design, interconnection, utility markets, and construction processes. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to lead matrixed design teams and manage client-approved engineering consultants.

The successful candidate will:

Responsible for the management of assigned projects; Function as the project manager / program manager
Take ownership of internal project financials, staffing, legal coordination, and risk management.
Facilitate planning and kickoff meetings to ensure alignment among all project stakeholders.
Support projects through complete life cycle including the feasibility phase, preliminary and detailed design, issue-for-bid, construction, start-up, and commissioning
Facilitate the design process, including conducting "page-turn design reviews" and equipment fabrication reviews at key project milestones (30%, 60%, and 100% design completion).
Work closely with the technical delivery team (incl subcontractors) to confirm deliverables and services are being provided to exceed client’s satisfaction. This includes coordination with team members across the world
Deliver projects in accordance with the AECOM Quality Management System (QMS) process
Proposal support / capture leadership to support business development activities
Identify project opportunities early and facilitate go/no-go decisions, determine project fees, write proposals, prepare and lead client presentations, and negotiation of contracts
Client development through existing contracts/relationships including managing key accounts and developing new accounts
Occasional travel to client or project sites

Level specific responsibilities:

Responsible for the overall management administration to project and assists in establishing project specific objectives and policies.
Provides management and guidance to subordinate managers, enforces company and project policies, and a primary liaison between AECOM and client interface.
Oversees and ensures all facets of the project are delivered in accordance with design, budget and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors.
Responsible for administering the project from budgeting/schedule stage through procurement and contract closeout. Position has significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned project.

AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

BA/BS in Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related degree and 6 years of relevant project management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Project Management experience directly related to power generation projects
Demonstrated experience delivering complex engineering projects and/or programs

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional (PMP)
Professional Engineering Licensure (PE)
Nuclear project experience
+15 Years of relevant experience, power generation or heavy industrial
Experience in managing projects worked in collaborative model environments (e.g. Navisworks, BIM/ACC)
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively manage diverse teams and stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage large-scale, complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated success working in a remote team environment

Additional Information

Relocation assistance may be available for this position

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $140000 to $180000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Role Description

Technical Program Manager

Project Manager II

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) with strong software development program experience to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, and client stakeholders.

The Opportunity

Lead and execute cross-functional software development programs spanning engineering, product management, QA, DevOps, and operations teams.
Own program schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and executive-level reporting.
Translate business and product requirements into clear technical execution plans.
Drive program execution across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
Coordinate delivery across backend services, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and cloud-based systems.
Facilitate Agile program-level ceremonies including PI planning, release planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Identify and proactively mitigate technical, execution, and dependency risks.
Manage cross-team and cross-geo dependencies to ensure alignment and accountability.
Track and communicate program health using metrics related to schedule, quality, scope, and resource utilization.
Support client interactions, executive reviews, and stakeholder communications.
Drive change management, scope trade-offs, and prioritization decisions to meet delivery commitments.
Partner with engineering leadership to align on architecture, design decisions, and technical dependencies.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need

8+ years of experience managing software development programs or technical project delivery.
Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-based applications.
Hands-on experience managing programs involving:
Backend systems and microservices
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Enterprise or large-scale software applications
Deep understanding of Agile / Scrum / SAFe methodologies.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional and client-facing programs.
Strong program management, execution discipline, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to drive risk management, technical triage, and data-driven decision-making.
Desired Skills:
Prior experience as a Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Architect.
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and production operations.
Experience working in client delivery or matrixed environments.
Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar tools.
PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile certifications (preferred but optional).
Qualification:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Redmond, Washington

Compensation Range
:
$102,000-$153,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

What We Believe

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior
Project Manager
to support our multi-disciplinary design team addressing the most challenging engineering tasks in power generation. AECOM's broad technical capabilities, global footprint and experience in executing large scale projects uniquely position us to lead in renewable, traditional steam, thermal power generation and advanced nuclear technologies.

This includes being a part of the first-of-a-kind program with AECOM partners advancing the innovative stellarator technology to the world.

https://aecom.com/press-releases/aecom-establishes-partnership-with-type-one-energy-to-provide-design-engineering-services-for-its-innovative-stellarator-fusion-power-plant-infinity-two/

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

We seek a project professional able to manage the project lifecycle from the project basis of design stage through the issuance of deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination between internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a strong understanding of engineering design, interconnection, utility markets, and construction processes. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to lead matrixed design teams and manage client-approved engineering consultants.

The successful candidate will:

Responsible for the management of assigned projects; Function as the project manager / program manager
Take ownership of internal project financials, staffing, legal coordination, and risk management.
Facilitate planning and kickoff meetings to ensure alignment among all project stakeholders.
Support projects through complete life cycle including the feasibility phase, preliminary and detailed design, issue-for-bid, construction, start-up, and commissioning
Facilitate the design process, including conducting "page-turn design reviews" and equipment fabrication reviews at key project milestones (30%, 60%, and 100% design completion).
Work closely with the technical delivery team (incl subcontractors) to confirm deliverables and services are being provided to exceed client’s satisfaction. This includes coordination with team members across the world
Deliver projects in accordance with the AECOM Quality Management System (QMS) process
Proposal support / capture leadership to support business development activities
Identify project opportunities early and facilitate go/no-go decisions, determine project fees, write proposals, prepare and lead client presentations, and negotiation of contracts
Client development through existing contracts/relationships including managing key accounts and developing new accounts
Occasional travel to client or project sites

Level specific responsibilities:

Responsible for the overall management administration to project and assists in establishing project specific objectives and policies.
Provides management and guidance to subordinate managers, enforces company and project policies, and a primary liaison between AECOM and client interface.
Oversees and ensures all facets of the project are delivered in accordance with design, budget and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors.
Responsible for administering the project from budgeting/schedule stage through procurement and contract closeout. Position has significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned project.

AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

BA/BS in Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related degree and 6 years of relevant project management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Project Management experience directly related to power generation projects
Demonstrated experience delivering complex engineering projects and/or programs

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional (PMP)
Professional Engineering Licensure (PE)
Nuclear project experience
+15 Years of relevant experience, power generation or heavy industrial
Experience in managing projects worked in collaborative model environments (e.g. Navisworks, BIM/ACC)
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively manage diverse teams and stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage large-scale, complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated success working in a remote team environment

Additional Information

Relocation assistance may be available for this position

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $140000 to $180000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Foundational Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

Elevate your career by driving strategic portfolio initiatives that optimize vendor spend, strengthen governance, and improve operational efficiency across Foundational Services.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager
within Foundational Services
, you will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives focused on vendor strategy, spend optimization, contract governance, and portfolio management. You will partner with Product Line Leaders, Finance, Vendor Management, Sourcing, Legal, and Technology stakeholders to drive commercial outcomes while balancing cost, risk, service quality, and strategic objectives. Your advanced analytical reasoning, financial acumen, and ability to influence across organizations will enable you to translate business, technical, financial, and operational priorities into actionable programs that deliver measurable results. In this role, you will help shape governance practices, improve transparency into vendor performance and spending, and establish scalable operating mechanisms that support long-term portfolio management objectives.

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and implement strategic portfolio management plans aligned with organizational goals, overseeing complex initiatives focused on vendor strategy, spend optimization, contract governance, and commercial performance.
Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate portfolio planning, spend analysis, dependency identification, risk synthesis, and executive-ready reporting while validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
Own the Foundational Services vendor spend efficiency agenda, identifying, prioritizing, and tracking cost optimization opportunities across a broad portfolio of products and services.
Lead proactive contract renewal planning, partnering with Vendor Management, Sourcing, Finance, and Legal to coordinate commercial reviews, negotiation strategies, risk assessments, and execution plans.
Establish and maintain vendor strategies across product domains, including vendor rationalization, consolidation opportunities, demand management initiatives, and service-level optimization.
Foster strong relationships with stakeholders and cross-functional teams, providing leadership, governance, and decision-making frameworks that drive beneficial outcomes.
Drive commercial optimization initiatives through benchmarking, pricing model analysis, consumption management, license optimization, rate-card reviews, and identification of duplicative services.
Establish governance forums and operating cadences for spend management, contract oversight, vendor performance reviews, and executive reporting.
Collaborate with Finance to establish spend baselines, validate savings and cost avoidance opportunities, forecast financial impacts, and track benefits realization.
Champion continuous improvement by identifying process optimization opportunities, enhancing portfolio analytics and reporting capabilities, and adopting best practices that improve transparency and decision-making.
Promote reuse-first, AI-assisted practices for portfolio governance and continuous improvement routines while ensuring appropriate human review and compliance with delivery standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

7+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, portfolio management, technology finance, vendor management, sourcing, commercial management, or related disciplines within large organizations (NAMR/APAC-India/LATAM/Hong Kong) Formal training or certification in program management, portfolio management, finance, sourcing, vendor management, or related disciplines with advanced applied experience (EMEA/LATAM-Brazil), Singapore follows local country guidance
Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support portfolio management, financial analysis, governance, and reporting workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
Ability to review and validate AI-assisted plans, risks, recommendations, financial analyses, and reporting outputs before use, escalating when appropriate and following data handling requirements.
Advanced analytical reasoning skills with the ability to synthesize spend, contract, operational, and financial data into actionable recommendations and strategic decisions.
Strong understanding of vendor commercial constructs, including licensing models, consumption-based pricing, renewal terms, volume tiers, benchmarking methodologies, notice periods, and contractual obligations.
Proven ability to lead through change, manage complex dependencies, and drive execution across multiple stakeholders in dynamic environments.
Experience delivering measurable cost optimization, savings, cost avoidance, or operational efficiency initiatives supported by disciplined governance and benefits realization practices.
Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, establishing productive partnerships and influencing outcomes across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Sourcing, Vendor Management, and Legal organizations.
Strong executive communication skills, including governance leadership, concise written communications, presentation development, and issue escalation management.
Advanced proficiency with Excel and experience leveraging analytical and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Power Query, Alteryx, Python, or comparable technologies.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience supporting Foundational Services, infrastructure platforms, enterprise tooling, end-user services, managed services, security services, or similar technology domains.
Experience operating in a regulated environment with exposure to third-party risk management, resiliency requirements, vendor performance management, and governance controls.
Demonstrated success building scalable operating mechanisms such as renewal pipelines, vendor scorecards, quarterly business reviews, category strategies, and portfolio governance frameworks.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, technology operations, and enterprise service delivery cost drivers, including capacity, utilization, consumption patterns, entitlements, and service levels.
Experience developing executive-level portfolio dashboards, financial reporting, and strategic planning materials for senior leadership.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

About The Team

Our Global Technology Infrastructure group is a team of innovators who love technology as much as you do. Together, you'll use a disciplined, innovative and a business focused approach to develop a wide variety of high-quality products and solutions. You'll work in a stable, resilient and secure operating environment where you—and the products you deliver—will thrive.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager, Devices
jobs.description:
About Atomic Machines:

Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital, but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi-process, multi-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device, made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform, addressing a critical need in the rapidly evolving AI data center world, and we are commercializing it now.

Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Program Manager to own the program for that first device's successor, end to end: from requirements still maturing with lead customers, through qualification, certification, and manufacturing scale-up on the Matter Compiler, to commercial launch. That successor is a new class of micromachine, made possible only by the Matter Compiler, and you will be the leader that delivers it.

At Atomic Machines, Program Management is a leverage function, and its core skill is clarity. The Device program's technical leadership is already in place: device design, process, test, and reliability are each led by deep domain owners who move fast and expect the same. You lead that team as one program, and you drive the outcome, integrated plan, customer commitments, tradeoffs, operating cadence, and decisions that keep every discipline moving as one. Technical direction belongs to the domain owners; turning their work into the outcomes of certified, scaling, revenue-generating products belongs to you. This role is for someone who was an individual contributor in complex technical domains and moved into program leadership on purpose: to influence product direction, align engineering and manufacturing, and own outcomes end to end.

What You'll Do:

Develop and drive the program roadmap end to end: set goals, define milestones and evidence gates, and build the accountability structure that connects daily engineering work to business outcomes and customer commitments.
Direct cross-functional execution across device physics, fabrication processes, automation, and system integration: set the deliverables, sequencing, and resource calls for engineering, operations, and leadership.
Build and run the integrated plan connecting customer commitments, design maturity, process capability, and manufacturing readiness. Run the operating cadence that keeps it honest.
Turn maturing customer requirements into committed, testable targets, and hold the program to them.
Build the program structures that keep device and process development in lockstep with the Matter Compiler platform. Move development from R&D into production and define what each handoff must prove.
Structure the program around evidence and short learning loops: design the build-test-learn iteration cycles, give every open unknown an experiment with a pass/fail criterion, and let the schedule follow from results.
Own the qualification and certification path (e.g., UL/IEC) as a program commitment shaped into the design from day one.
Deliver the outcome: the device demonstrated, evaluated by lead customers, and qualified through production ramp.
Institutionalize what you learn: build the systems, rhythms, and decision structures the whole organization runs on, so the next program moves faster than this one.

What You'll Need:

8+ years spanning hands-on engineering and technical program leadership on complex multidisciplinary hardware: you have personally taken things from thought to build and owned programs that others depended on.
A track record of taking integrated hardware systems from concept through manufacturing release and commercial delivery, with the judgment to know when a decision needs more rigor and when to move fast.
Deep technical fluency in at least one core engineering domain and productive command across the rest: you hold your own with engineers designing in coupled physical domains — electromagnetics, structural mechanics, thermal behavior, fluidics, and materials.
You drive senior technical leads to deliver at a high level: clarity, structure, and pace, while technical direction stays with the domain owner.
Relentlessness in driving through ambiguity: turning unresolved requirements into scope, evidence gates, and a plan the team runs.
Conviction in iterative hardware development and short learning loops — build early, test early, learn fast, continually finding the shortest learning loop.
True Ownership of your program and domain, with bottom-line-up-front communication, trusted by engineers and leadership alike. The strongest people you've worked with would choose to work with you again.
BS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Materials Science.

Nice to Have:

Reliability engineering for microscale or precision devices: accelerated life testing, environmental stress testing, and long-term performance characterization.
Experience driving a product through UL, IEC, or equivalent certification.
Experience standing up programs from ground zero, then driving reliability growth to manufacturing scale.

At Amazon, our vision is to become the most customer-centric company on earth. Achieving this goal requires ensuring we continue to work with carriers who are good actors and share this same vision. A key way we accomplish this is through rigorous business intelligence, operational deep dives, and data-driven accountability that enables our teams to deliver flawless execution at scale.

You will lead a high-visibility program responsible for business reporting, operational deep dives, and cross-organizational accountability for one of Amazon's most critical transportation networks. You will conduct rigorous root cause analyses to identify failure modes, translating complex findings into clear, actionable narratives. You will investigate carrier feedback at scale, synthesizing signals and routing prioritized insights to the appropriate product and engineering teams to drive systemic improvements.

You will be the connective tissue between operations, product, engineering, and senior leadership, bridging technical depth with executive-level storytelling. You will own business goal tracking for the organization, building mechanisms that ensure accountability across multiple teams and organizations for issue resolution and action item closure. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and proactively present new insights in a concise and effective manner.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, can context-switch between a deep technical investigation and an executive-ready narrative within the same day, and has a bias for action when it comes to closing gaps. You will work directly with partners across product management, engineering, data science, and operations to ensure our reporting infrastructure is robust, our metrics are trustworthy, and our leadership has the information they need to make both high-quality and high-velocity decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end business reporting within the TTS organization for Delivery Accuracy within Middle Mile, delivering high-fidelity operational insights to Director and VP-level audiences on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence
Drive cross-org VP and SVP-level goals related to improving Middle Mile Delivery Accuracy.
Operate within a culture of escalate and debate
Conduct rigorous operational deep dives to identify root causes and failure modes within business logic, data pipelines, SOPs, and technology systems, translating findings into actionable recommendations and driving resolution through cross-functional coordination
Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to align on reporting priorities and ensure shared visibility into program health and goal attainment
Support in working with other product and program managers globally to identify reporting gaps, systemic issues, and opportunities for process and tooling improvement
Dive deep into data to uncover reporting discrepancies, metric anomalies, and operational trends that unlock new opportunities for improvement
Investigate and synthesize carrier feedback at scale, distilling actionable themes and routing prioritized insights to the appropriate product and engineering teams with clear context and recommended next steps
Own business goal tracking for the organization, building and maintaining mechanisms that ensure transparency into progress, blockers, and risk across multiple teams and senior leadership
Create, maintain, and disseminate program information to stakeholders and leadership across the organization via business reviews, flash reports, and operational readouts, identifying potential bottlenecks, dependencies, or project risks
Drive cross-organizational accountability for issue tracking, escalation management, and action item closure; establishing mechanisms that ensure nothing falls through the cracks
Partner across product and engineering teams to apply new technologies, automation, and tooling to improve reporting infrastructure and operational efficiency

A day in the life

On any given day, you might start by investigating an anomaly that resulted in a customer promise miss, tracing it through reporting logic and tech systems to identify the root cause. By mid-morning, you're synthesizing carrier feedback into a concise brief for the Operations and Product team, then pivoting to prepare a business review narrative for senior leadership (Director/VP). Afternoons could involve driving accountability in a cross-functional stand-up with operations, program management, and product managers, tracking action items to closure, or building the weekly operational readout that keeps our organization aligned. Your internal stakeholders span Product, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations Supply Chain leadership. Your customers are the senior leaders who depend on accurate, timely insights to make high-quality decisions, and the product, program, and operations teams who rely on your investigations to prioritize the right problems.

About The Team

The Technology Transportation Services (TTS) organization builds software systems that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both time and cost of getting the packages delivered. Our services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers, owner operators and drivers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers. That said, this remains a fast growing business and our technical journey has only started. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, unique delivery models for products ranging from Amazon Fresh groceries, ultra-fast Prime Now deliveries of big-screen TV’s, increasingly complex transportation network, and growing number of shipments worldwide, we see a massive opportunity to fundamentally change the way people get the stuff they need, and make a big impact by cutting billions of dollars of transportation costs from the ecosystem. Our mission is to build the most efficient and optimal transportation solution on the planet, using our science and technology muscle as our biggest advantage.

Who we are
Arena Physica is on a mission to accelerate hardware innovation that powers human progress. Our name is inspired by Theodore Roosevelt's 'Citizenship in a Republic' speech. To us, entering the Arena means committing fully and accepting the risk of failure in pursuit of an audacious, worthy cause. We believe the future belongs to those brave enough to build it.

Our team of 50 combines AI engineering and applied physics expertise with deep experience in enterprise deployments. We're headquartered in NYC with presences in San Francisco and Los Angeles, backed by ~$90M from Initialized, Founders Fund, Goldcrest Capital, Fifth Down Capital, and Shield Capital.

If you're ready to do the most important work of your career, join us in the Arena.

What we do
At Arena Physica, we're building electromagnetic superintelligence. Our AI platform Atlas operationalizes physics-grounded intelligence to verify, debug, and optimize hardware across its lifecycle. Atlas is already trusted globally by the world's most advanced hardware companies, including AMD, Anduril, and Bausch & Lomb, for applications across R&D, integration testing, production assembly, and field repair.

About the role
As a Deployment Strategist, you will own the success of an Atlas deployment from end to end—from use case identification and workflow mapping to new feature development that accelerate hardware innovation.

Working on fast timelines, you'll collaborate closely with customers, users, and Arena Physica's engineering, and GTM teams to successfully deploy Atlas, while measuring and demonstrating real-world value. Your responsibilities include building a deep understanding of your users, their organizations, and their workflows, then identifying how new or existing Atlas features will transform their processes. You'll work directly with customers to remove technical and organizational blockers, making you a key player in their success.

In close collaboration with our engineering team, you'll work with Arena Physica's Head of Forward Deployed Engineering and Head of Product to identify and develop new features that deliver maximum value to users in real-world scenarios. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience driving innovation across some of the world's most vital industries — ideal for those aspiring to become founders or product leaders.

How you will contribute
Deployment ownership - own deployment execution for one or more customer accounts from technical strategy to stakeholder management, and develop deep understanding of our users. Ensure deployment success through consistent on-site presence and building strong relationships across the organization.
Drive user adoption - drive usage of Atlas with our customers, and provide structured, technical product feedback to our Core Product and Platform engineering teams to shape our product roadmap.
Foster and grow relationships with users and senior technical/business leadership - lead technical conversations with senior customer leadership and technical users as our domain expert at the intersection of AI and Electrical Engineering.
Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50% of your time)
Work in person at Arena Physica's NYC HQ when not traveling

You have
4+ years of professional experience, ideally as an engineer or TPM working in industry – at a leading company in Aerospace, Automotive or Semiconductors
Full-stack technical literacy - you are well versed across a wide range of technical topics with deep expertise in select areas, and you are eager and able to pick up new depths easily
Product-fluency - you have worked closely with product teams, understand the user journey, and can balance technical product development with practical user needs.
A strong ability to understand and articulate how AI-native products create commercial value
Strong written and verbal communication & storytelling – you can communicate your ideas clearly and concisely in a medium of your choosing to a wide variety of stakeholders

Benefits & Perks Include:
100% of the monthly premium for Aetna medical insurance, plus vision and dental coverage
401(k) Retirement Plan
Unlimited PTO
Lunch every day from local restaurants via Sharebite
Relocation support provided

jobs.title: Program Manager, Voice of the Member
jobs.description:
About The Role

At Chime, we believe the best decisions start with a deep understanding of our members. As part of the Voice of the Member team, you'll help uncover what members are experiencing, why it matters, and how Chime can respond.

You'll help deepen and scale that understanding across the company by turning member sentiment, feedback, and other experience signals into actionable insights. Working across sources like support conversations, social channels, app reviews, surveys, and operational data, you'll identify meaningful patterns, investigate emerging issues, and help teams make more informed decisions on behalf of our members. You'll also experiment with AI, automations, and new ways of delivering insights so teams can access and act on the member perspective more quickly and effectively.

This role is ideal for someone who loves solving ambiguous problems, connecting dots across multiple sources of information, and turning complex information into clear, compelling stories. You'll partner closely with product teams, business leaders, and executives to help ensure the member perspective is embedded in the decisions that matter most.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $105,000.00 and up to $145,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

Investigate the biggest sources of member frustration and delight across Chime, combining signals from feedback, support conversations, social channels, app reviews, and operational data to understand what's happening and why.
Build and evolve tools, automations, and AI-enabled workflows that help teams across Chime access, understand, and act on member insights more effectively.
Identify opportunities where manual analysis, reporting, or decision-making can be improved through automation, experimentation, and new approaches to surfacing member sentiment at scale.
Turn complex findings into clear, compelling narratives that help product teams, business leaders, and executives make better decisions on behalf of our members.
Lead deep-dive analyses on important member experience topics, identifying root causes, quantifying impact, and uncovering opportunities to improve the member experience.
Shape and deliver company-wide sentiment readouts that help Chime stay connected to what members are experiencing and where we should focus our attention.
Ask questions others aren't asking, proactively investigate emerging issues, and surface insights that help Chime better understand and serve its members.

To thrive in this role, you have

4+ years of experience in consulting, product management, product operations, strategy & operations, user research, customer insights, analytics, or similar roles that required structured problem solving and cross-functional influence.
A track record of turning complex information into clear, compelling narratives that help others understand what matters and what to do next.
Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with both quantitative and qualitative data. You know how to ask thoughtful questions, separate signal from noise, and build confidence in your conclusions.
A high degree of curiosity, ownership, and self-motivation. You're energized by ambiguous problems, proactively explore new ideas, and don't wait for someone else to tell you what to investigate next.
Experience using AI tools to learn quickly, investigate problems, automate workflows, or improve how work gets done. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're excited to experiment and continuously expand your toolkit.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor your message for audiences ranging from individual contributors to senior leaders and executives.
A genuine curiosity about what drives member experiences, paired with a desire to influence decisions that create meaningful impact at scale.

A Little About Us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What We Offer For Our Full-time, Regular Employees

🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Data & AI Governance Policy and Standards
jobs.description:
Company Summary

EchoStar is reimagining the future of connectivity. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products.

Today, our brands include Boost Mobile, DISH TV, Gen Mobile, Hughes and Sling TV.

Department Summary

Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our team members play a vital role in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.

This role bridges the gap between high-level regulatory requirements and day-to-day data/AI projects and operations. Direct involvement in AI and data governance operational workflows ensures that company policies, standard operating procedures, and standards are actionable and practical across business units. The position addresses the challenge of converting complex emerging frameworks into clear execution standards while preventing policy bloat through continuous cross-functional feasibility testing.

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

Draft, review, and update actionable governance policies, standards, and procedures to align operations with organizational objectives
Maintain the Dictionary of Policies, Classifications, and Standards with strict version control and seamless access
Translate emerging frameworks like NIST AI RMF, Colorado Automated Decision-Making Technology Act (ADMTA), and EU AI Act into practical operational checklists
Road-test new standards alongside engineering, data science, and product teams to eliminate friction
Create decision trees, templates, and guides that enable measurable governance reporting
Connect Governance Leadership with Forward Deployed Expertise teams to drive cross-departmental execution

Skills, Experience And Requirements

Core Skills and Competencies (What you’ll bring):

AI application expertise using modern AI tools to streamline automation and boost governance workflow productivity
Ability to design logical, version-controlled policy frameworks accessible to non-legal business units
Ability to identify specific metadata, logging requirements, and testing protocols for regulatory alignment
Strong cross-functional collaboration and influence skills to bridge business, risk, and technical execution teams
Critical experience with standardized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
Advanced process engineering expertise to convert complex requirements into frictionless workflows

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Policy, Data Science, Computer Science, or Engineering
5 years of experience in AI/Data Governance, Technical Policy, Process Engineering, or Compliance
NIST AI Risk Management Framework
Decision-to-data mapping and policy drafting

Visa sponsorship not available for this role

Salary Ranges

Compensation: $96,250.00/Year - $137,500.00/Year
