jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘 NOT:The line manager is foreign. Full English interview required. Please submit your English resume.

【职位概述】 协助全球首席合规官，完善并落地ETS全球隐私计划在中国及亚太地区的本地化工作。本职位负责将ETS隐私政策与隐私声明的要求转化为实际运营流程，同时确保符合《个人信息保护法》《网络安全法》《数据安全法》等中国隐私法律，以及GDPR、ISO 27701等适用全球标准。理想人选需牵头跨部门协作，将隐私管理规范融入ETS各业务单元日常运营，重点聚焦中国市场合规工作。 Support the Global Chief Compliance Officer in enhancing and localizing the ETS Global Privacy Program for China and the Asia-Pacific region. This role is responsible for operationalizing the requirements of ETS's Privacy Policy and Privacy Statement while ensuring alignment with Chinese privacy laws such as the Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL), Cybersecurity Law, and Data Security Law, along with applicable global standards (e.g. GDPR, ISO 27701). The ideal candidate will lead cross-functional collaboration to embed privacy practices into ETS’s daily operations across business units, with a particular focus on compliance within the China market. 【主要职责】 1. 审核、修订并维护内部标准、流程及业务规范，推动ETS隐私政策与隐私声明落地，确保符合中国法律及全球最佳实践。 Review, adapt, and maintain internal standards, procedures, and business rules to operationalize ETS’s Privacy Policy and Privacy Notice in compliance with Chinese laws and global best practices. 2. 管理个人信息权利请求（数据主体请求）流程，支持内部升级处理，确保及时、合规解决相关诉求。 Manage the Personal Information Rights Request (Data Subject Request) process and support internal escalations, ensuring timely and compliant resolution. 3. 开展隐私影响评估，组织或指导开展同类隐私与安全评估工作。 Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments and conduct or direct similar privacy and security assessments. 4. 维护并定期更新个人信息处理活动记录，尤其针对跨境数据传输相关内容。 Maintain and regularly update records of processing activities, especially in relation to cross-border data transfers. 5. 协助制作并维护数据流图及技术/数据处理流程图。 Support the creation and upkeep of data flow diagrams and technology/data processing maps. 6. 为亚太地区各团队及相关人员提供隐私培训，开展隐私合规宣导工作。 Deliver privacy training and awareness initiatives to teams and stakeholders across the region. 7. 参与或牵头内部隐私审计、合规监控及控制测试工作。 Participate in or lead internal privacy audits, monitoring, and control testing initiatives. 8. 协同法务部门及本地管理层，配合中国监管机构问询、处理消费者投诉。 Support response efforts to Chinese regulatory authorities and consumer complaints, in coordination with Legal and local management. 9. 熟练掌握中国现行隐私法规、韩印等重点亚太地区及全球隐私标准，为业务提供本地合规落地建议。 Maintain strong working knowledge of applicable Chinese privacy regulations, significant regional (Korea and India) and global privacy standards, advising the business on local implementation. 【知识与技能】 1. 具备出色的人际沟通与协调能力，可在多元文化环境中为各级人员（包括高层管理者）提供专业建议并推动落地。 Strong interpersonal and communication skills to advise and influence across business levels, including senior management in a multicultural setting. 2. 深入理解中国数据保护相关法律（《个人信息保护法》《数据安全法》《网络安全法》），熟悉GDPR等国际隐私框架；愿意主动学习亚太地区各国隐私法规。 In-depth understanding of China’s data protection laws (PIPL, DSL, CSL) and working knowledge of international privacy frameworks (e.g. GDPR). Willingness to gain expertise in regional privacy laws is expected. 3. 具备隐私与数据保护运营实操经验，涵盖技术与流程层面的保障措施。 Hands-on knowledge of privacy and data protection operational practices, including technical and procedural safeguards. 4. 具备项目管理能力，可同时牵头或支持多项工作开展。 Project management skills with the ability to lead or support multiple initiatives simultaneously. 5. 注重细节，能够将复杂的法规条款转化为可落地的业务要求。 High attention to detail and ability to interpret complex regulatory language into business requirements. 6. 具备分析与数据处理能力，熟练使用Excel、PowerPoint、SharePoint及其他协作工具。 Analytical and data-literate, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and other collaboration tools. 7. 具备流利的中英文工作能力，双语流利为必备要求。 Ability to work effectively in both English and Mandarin (fluency in both languages required). 【教育背景与工作经验】 必备条件 1. 本科及以上学历，法律、信息安全或相关专业。 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (in Law, Information Security, or related field). 2. 3-5年跨国企业或中国本土企业隐私项目管理、数据保护、科技法律相关直接工作经验。 3–5 years of direct experience in privacy program management, data protection, or technology law in a multinational or Chinese enterprise environment. 3. 持有隐私或数据保护专业认证，如CIPP/A、CIPP/E、CIPM。 Professional certification in privacy or data protection (e.g., CIPP/A, CIPP/E, CIPM). 优先条件 1. 法学硕士（LLM）、法律博士（JD）或本地法律职业资格。 Advanced degree in Law (LLM or JD) or local legal qualifications. 2. 有与中国监管机构对接或跨境数据传输评估相关工作经验。 Prior experience working with Chinese regulators or cross-border data transfer assessments. 3. 有设计并落地隐私培训与合规宣导项目的经验。 Experience designing and implementing privacy training and awareness campaigns. 4. 有牵头跨职能团队或隐私专项工作组的经验。 Experience leading cross-functional teams or privacy working groups.

This role is responsible for planning, directing, and monitoring multi‑workstream efforts; managing cost, schedule, and performance baselines; and ensuring contractor resources execute work in alignment with NIH, CIT, and BAS priorities. Jede Geschichte zählt. Gestalte deine eigene – gemeinsam mit uns bei Riverty.

Und wohin führt dich das?

In eine unserer 30 hybriden Arbeitsumgebungen – gestaltet für den Austausch von Ideen, gemeinsames Lernen und die Mitgestaltung unserer Arbeitsweise. Werde Teil einer internationalen Community mit über 4.000 Menschen aus fast 80 Nationen in 11 Ländern. Vereint durch eine gemeinsame Mission: Mit Empathie, moderner Technologie und datengestützten Erkenntnissen dafür zu sorgen, dass Menschen und Unternehmen im Fluss bleiben. Mit Zahlungsprozessen, die für sie erledigt werden – damit sie sich darum keine Sorgen machen müssen.

Und das ist noch nicht alles:
Wir sind Teil der Bertelsmann-Gruppe, die in Familienbesitz ist. Etabliert. Unternehmerisch. In einer dynamischen Branche. Wir ermöglichen flexible Bezahloptionen in verschiedenen Branchen, vereinfachen das Finanzmanagement bekannter Marken und unterstützen Menschen dabei, Schulden abzubauen und finanzielle Sicherheit zu gewinnen. Kurz gesagt: Wir gestalten FinTech.

Wir suchen Unterstützung als (Senior) Program Manager Operational Excellence & Transformation (m/w/d)
(unbefristet, Vollzeit) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an einem unserer Standorte in Berlin, Verl oder Münster zum Aufbau der nächsten Generation von AI-Powered Operations - flexible Arbeitsbedingungen verfügbar.

In dieser Rolle treibst du die Transformation unserer internationalen Collections Operations voran. Du steuerst strategische Initiativen entlang der Transformationsagenda und übernimmst gleichzeitig die eigenständige Leitung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Projekte mit klarem Fokus auf messbare operative Verbesserungen und nachhaltigen Business Impact.

Hauptaufgaben

Verantwortung für die Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung eines internationalen Portfolios strategischer Transformations- und Operational-Excellence-Initiativen im Collections-Umfeld.
Identifikation, Priorisierung und Umsetzung von Automatisierungs-, KI- und Prozessoptimierungsmaßnahmen entlang der Collections- und Customer-Service-Prozesse zur nachhaltigen Verbesserung operativer Kennzahlen und Geschäftsergebnisse.

Eigenständige Leitung strategischer, funktionsübergreifender Projekte und enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Transformationsagenda.

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finanzen, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Leitung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen, idealerweise im internationalen Operations- oder Customer-Service-Umfeld.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Effizienz-, Automatisierungs-, Digitalisierungs- oder KI-Initiativen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für KPI-basierte Steuerung.
Souveränes Auftreten und ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, verbunden mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen adressatengerecht aufzubereiten, Entscheidungen herbeizuführen und unterschiedliche Interessen in internationalen Matrixorganisationen zusammenzuführen.
Erfahrung im Collections-Umfeld sowie fundiertes Verständnis operativer Customer-Service-Prozesse, idealerweise einschließlich Front- und Backoffice-Prozessen, Automatisierung und digitaler Kundeninteraktionen.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Tetra Tech AMT is looking for a Senior Operations Research Analyst/Data Scientist to support a highly visible new FAA project in the initial stand up of executable processes and analytics at the direction of FAA management for pre-departure planning.

Primary job duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to the following:

Establish a process for strategic deconfliction in collaboration with internal and external aviation stakeholders for a new FAA Traffic Flow Management Evolution Program for a potential “24/7” operation
Work 40 hours a week but potentially work late night shifts and weekends at times to cover overnight and weekend data modeling needs
Collect historical data, observe network of applicable systems in action, and interview stakeholders to understand operational bottlenecks and business process inefficiencies
Using programming languages, along with specialized software, to potentially build quantitative models to simulate various scenarios
Help determine the most efficient and ideal best course of action (e.g., build data models that translate to lower fuel burden, less aircraft downtime, shorter block times, and faster flights) given a strict set of real-world constraints
Document the FAA process, roles, and responsibilities to enable execution of strategic deconfliction process plan for day of operations in the National Airspace System (NAS) Work with FAA and industry vendor(s) who will architect and build the analytical data model and provide feedback as necessary
Collaborate with FAA stakeholders and external industry partners (as needed) to obtain necessary data to operate logistically optimized model
Enter data into analytical models (long range and same day planning) to develop strategic deconfliction plans
As needed, support the training of FAA staff on process execution related to newly designed traffic flow management program
Document all lessons learned and FAA process improvement opportunities for evolution of strategic deconfliction processes/capability
Apply knowledge in the domain of operations research to optimize NAS strategic deconfliction plan
Define post event analysis criteria and data expectations
Document recommended process improvement opportunities
Provide expertise in the design, development, implementation, and analysis of technical FAA products and systems

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Have deep expertise in data collection and modeling in support of the federal government and preferably in support of FAA mission
Deep analytical thinking, strong programming skills, and the ability to translate highly technical data into actionable, strategic recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Have some background in air traffic management and airport operations including FAA traffic flow management practices
Possess broad knowledge of operations research procedures, methodologies, and can provide technical expertise in the application of state-of-the-art technology to meet FAA mission and aerospace requirements
Flexible work schedule that may require working at FAA in-person and cover nights, weekends and even some holidays during the year as this is in support of a national and highly visible FAA project
Potentially be on call to cover shifts when anticipated higher days of operations or team members are unavailable/on scheduled vacation
Must have at least 10 years of professional years of experience supporting projects as an Operations Research Analyst but preferably in support of the FAA/NASA or at least the federal government
Must have a Bachelor of Science Degree in engineering (e.g. Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics) or related field

Salary: $120,000 to $130,000 annually. Compensation is based on relevant experience and qualifications.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

The Project Manager must possess the ability to multi-task while maintaining attention to detail and must be highly organized. This position requires hands on experience related to Scheduling, Written and Verbal Communication, and/or general construction practices. The Project Manager must be willing to travel locally (40-50%) and out of market (15-20%) as required by project. This position reports to the Director of Operations & Vice President.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Onsite project management lead for all greater NY based jobs – approx 40-50% out of office in market.
Complete daily progress reports with crew attendance, photos & completion metrics for each day a job is active in the field.
Conduct site visits as needed for any greater NY area jobs.
Travel out of market as needed when nationwide project management bandwidth is limited during busier times – approx 15-20% out of market travel.
Per diem & travel expenses covered for all out of market travel to jobs/site visits.
Accompany clients, building dept, fire marshals etc on walkthroughs to inspect & confirm all installations are built to code & clients agreed to desires; acquire sign off on all projects prior to completion & exiting the job site.
Oversee project prep in Hauppauge WH prior to events – including but not limited to tools, hardware, materials & other misc equipment needs.
Assist with local project planning, schedules & logistics.
Ensure crews attend safety orientations, are up to date on all safety requirements & adhere to all safety regulations & have proper PPE while working.
Manage all job specific purchasing & procurement.
Assist WH manager with creation & verification of BOLs on inbound & outbound material.
Assist in development of project cost estimates in collaboration with the sales team.
Coordinate and review all technical drawings with the CAD Department & project foreman to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite.
Coordinate and review detailed assembly/installation drawings with project foreman for use by the installation crew to ensure all details of job are captured prior to arriving onsite for load in.
Actively communicate with management & warehouse team to maintain shop production & logistics schedules in coordination with the project onsite.

Location: Hybrid - Honolulu, Hawaii ( 2 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: 12+ Months (With potential to become FTE)

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Financial Health Data Analyst I
to provide financial management, analysis, and reporting support for government and commercial programs, health plans, and provider contracts of our client. This role focuses on contract compliance, financial stewardship, benefit cost management, reimbursement strategies, data quality, and process improvement
. The successful candidate will analyze financial and operational data, identify trends and cost-reduction opportunities, support provider and program initiatives, and develop meaningful reports for management. The position operates with moderate management direction and oversight.

Financial & Provider Analysis

Monitor private and government websites for reimbursement and policy changes and recommend appropriate implementation.

Reporting & Business Analysis

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.description:
Job ID: req4669

Employee Type: exempt full-time

Division: Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate

Facility: Frederick: ATRF

Location: 8560 Progress Dr, Frederick, MD 21701 USA

The Frederick National Laboratory is operated by Leidos Biomedical Research, Inc. The lab addresses some of the most urgent and intractable problems in the biomedical sciences in cancer and AIDS, drug development and first-in-human clinical trials, applications of nanotechnology in medicine, and rapid response to emerging threats of infectious diseases.

Accountability, Compassion, Collaboration, Dedication, Integrity and Versatility; it's the FNL way.

Program Description

The Vaccine, Immunity and Cancer Directorate (VICD) has a primary mission to provide scientific leadership and laboratory infrastructure to study immune responses to Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines and other cancer preventive strategies in the context of preclinical and clinical studies. As of recent and part of a large effort, the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the Frederick National Laboratory (FNL) and other stakeholders are developing vaccines with durable protection for seasonal influenza virus. VICD is leading the development of immunoassays with the highest reproducibility, sensitivity, and specificity for evaluation of immune responses against the virus and vaccine.

VICD is recruiting for a Cross Functional Project Manager II to provide cross functional project management and programmatic operations. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working in a laboratory under the Good Clinical Laboratory Practices or GxP and is familiar with laboratory operations. The Cross Functional Project Manager II will report to the Director, Program and Operations, working with program directors, scientific managers and across matrix to meet the program and project goals, and assist and drive program activities to meet the deadlines for deliverables.

Key Roles/Responsibilities

Assist in the management of research subcontracts supporting the program
Manage administrative Program activities by performing a variety of high-level administrative and programmatic functions that include planning and implementation of overall Program strategies
Communicate effectively to compose both business and scientific documents and ensure efficient Program operations
Assist with overall coordination of Program/Project level functions
Ensure Program compliance with all policies and procedures related to project management, contract relations, purchasing, and fiscal planning
Provide meeting management support to Programs, including drafting agendas, meeting notes/minutes and recording, monitoring and follow-up action items with internal and external stakeholders as needed
Assist in the preparation of program reports, including monthly quarterly reports, semi-annual and annual reports
Assists with progress reporting, deliverables, and proposals, statement of work, and 508 compliance, other formal documents, formatting, editing, and submissions to appropriate systems and to stakeholders
Assist with personnel actions such as requisition postings, onboarding and off-boarding activities such as office setup, computer and equipment setup, folder access, etc.
Assists in the development of oral presentations and meetings with internal and external stakeholders
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for intellectual property requirements, CRADAs, MTAs, collaboration agreements, subcontracts
Work with managers to ensure laboratory and programs are operating in an efficient manner, providing administrative/operation support
Working directly with the laboratory to perform equipment request processing, equipment management, coordinating vendors to certification completion
Data entry for biological material inventory on an annual basis with accuracy Liaise with internal groups and other LBR groups (HR, Finance, Purchasing, Equipment, etc.) as required
Perform other related duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications

To be considered for this position, you must minimally meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below:

Possession of Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university according to the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or four (4) years relevant experience in lieu of degree. Foreign degrees must be evaluated for U.S. equivalency
In addition to the education requirement, a minimum of two (2) years of related experience managing research, experimental planning, proposal writing and project management
Working knowledge and facility with Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with these desired skills will be given preferential consideration:

Regulatory knowledge pertinent to standards GCLP, CLIA or FDA guidelines for clinical assays
Familiarity with immunoassays, testing, equipment maintenance, LIMS
Knowledge of CostPoint, Cognos, Corcentric, ERP
Knowledge of finance and budgeting

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

As a Staff TPM (AI) for our R&D PMO, you will lead the execution of our most critical Product development initiatives with AI embedded throughout the lifecycle. We lead both customer-facing GenAI product and platform programs and internal AI-enabled engineering transformation initiatives that improve how we build, operate, and deliver value. The Medallia R&D PMO team maintains a strong and strategic partnership with Product and Engineering, and together we are building solutions that are moving the Experience industry forward, delivering solutions that our customers love.

This is first and foremost a Technical Program Management (TPM) role. The ideal candidate brings strong TPM discipline, excellent cross-functional leadership, and AI fluency to work with business leaders on initiatives that automate workflows, improve decision-making, and increase productivity through AI and workflow automation capabilities.

Responsibilities

Lead multiple concurrent strategic initiatives and programs varying in size, scope, complexity and ambiguity, with cross-functional and cross-organizational dependencies.
Collaborate with multiple Product and Engineering teams across platform and applications
Take responsibility for the success and health of the Strategic Initiatives under your care and act as a change agent to drive operational efficiencies into process, people and tooling.
Proactively manage technical challenges & risks in all assigned areas; work with teams and management to mitigate these risks before they become issues.
Be sought after by leadership for “the real story” and craft communications that can be consumed at different levels of the organization.
Propose solutions and consult on system changes. Influence long lasting architecture along with documentation.
Ability to represent R&D by answering both technical and business-related questions on behalf of the team.
Continually pursue delivery excellence by improving predictability, efficiency and throughput.
Understand hybrid-cloud architecture, infrastructure, systems development, and cloud computing.
Amplify your impact by educating and mentoring the TPM, Operations, and Engineering communities on program management best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve execution of the organization as a whole, to increase Operations and Engineering productivity through tools and process improvements.
Understand the business metrics and operational controls required for production GenAI capabilities, and coordinate across teams to ensure telemetry for usage & monitoring, and fallback and rollback mechanisms

Candidates based in the Tysons vicinity will be prioritized as this role is Hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of leadership experience in Product / Engineering / PMO
5+ years of demonstrated experience working closely with C-level executives
3+ years of experience in Cloud / SaaS
Demonstrated success leading and managing large-scale initiatives across organizations in a matrixed, globally-diverse workforce
Demonstrated experience in delivering AI/ML or GenAI products or features from use-case definition thru production launch and post-launch iterations
Experience with AI model lifecycle
Exposure to responsible AI governance, and partnership with Security and Legal
Hands-on experience with GenAI development and productivity tools such as Claude, Cursor, etc. is expected.
Hands-on experience applying SDLC, Project Management, and Product Life-Cycle methodologies and configuring project management tooling (e.g. Jira and Confluence) to track roadmap progress, risk and deliverables.
Business Value & Metrics: Experience defining Key Performance Indicators, calculating ROI, and mapping technical program outcomes directly to business revenue, cost savings, or operational efficiency metrics.
Strategic & Tactical Execution: Track record of owning a technical program lifecycle from initial strategy and roadmap definition through to day-to-day execution, tracking, and delivery.
Systems & Process Architecture: Experience managing multi-million dollar or multi-team programs where you successfully integrated technical architecture, operational workflows, and business processes across distinct business units.
Executive Communication: Experience presenting program status, technical risks, and strategic trade-offs to VP and C-level executives, and translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leadership and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of people management skills
PMP, CSM, CPO, PgMP, IAPM, CISSP, ITIL, Six Sigma certifications
Experience with hybrid cloud solutions
Acquisition Integration experience
Adept at cultural change management
Curious, adaptable, and action-oriented in applying AI to real business problems and measurable outcomes.
Ability to thrive and succeed in a dynamic environment not slowed down by ambiguity or competing priorities
Able to effectively modulate the presentation of information based on your audience: everyone from a C-level executive to an Individual Contributor

Deputy Program Manager

Leidos
has an exciting and challenging opportunity for a Deputy Program Manager
in our Intel Sector’s Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA)

Job Summary

Leidos is seeking a Deputy Program Manager
to support a high-impact, multi-agency program serving the United States Space Force (USSF)/Space Systems Command (SSC), the United States Air Force (USAF), and other key mission stakeholders. The selected candidate will play critical role in overseeing a program focused on enhancing, testing, and deploying a large-scale Satellite Communications (SATCOM) system within an existing infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in public key infrastructure (PKI) and Agile development, along with exceptional problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. This position will support program execution across financial performance, workforce management, customer engagement, and contractual compliance, ensuring successful mission outcomes.

Responsibilities include tracking program status against customer and corporate requirements, supporting Earned Value Management reporting, aligning resources to program needs, preparing briefings and program documentation, responding to customer and company data calls, and helping resolve administrative and business issues. The role also supports talent development and overall program delivery in a complex, fast-paced, technical environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Oversee all program administrative and business operations, including Subcontracts, Earned Value Management, Finance, and Security.
Serve as a key Point of Contact for the Contracting Officer (CO), Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), Government Program Manager, and company senior leadership, including executive-level stakeholders.
Lead program operations in the absence of the Program Manager (PM) or when the PM is engaged in other critical program priorities.
Maintain full comprehensive awareness of program activities and serve as a secondary Point of Contact between program staff and Government stakeholders.
Manage operational execution and financial performance for contract deliverables, cost, and schedule to ensure achievement of all key performance indicators and annual operating plan commitments.
Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, the Statement of Work, and Leidos policies and procedures.
Serve as Control Account Manager (CAM) for the Program Management Office account.
Lead and support customer and internal meetings, including agenda development, coordination, and follow-up.
Prepare program reporting materials, including inputs for IPR, PSR, IPMDAR, and other formal reviews for Senior Leadership and Government PMOstakeholders.
Partner with functional support teams to ensure customer and company requirements are fully met.
Collaborate with highly technical teams to track program status and provide operational and management support as needed.
Coordinate the development of Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs) and support business development activities.
Review and approve Earned Value, Estimate to Complete, and other financial reports, as appropriate.
Communicate program issues, risks, and solutions to the Government Program Manager in a timely and transparent manner,as required.
Contribute to, review, and ensure the timely delivery of Program Management CDRL deliverables.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and at least 12 years of relevant experience. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
At least ten (10) years of experience as a Program or Project Manager, leading programs and contracts of significant scope, type, complexity, and impact.
At least one (1)year of experience managing and controlling program funds and resources using advanced reporting methods, including Earned Value Management (EVM).
Demonstrated experience in requirements analysis, resource allocation, project costing, deliverable tracking, and schedule and financial performance monitoring.
Proven leadership experience managing both direct reports and cross-functional teams.
Experience managing multiple subcontractors and teammates in support of program execution.
Strong ability to apply sound judgment and effective problem-solving skills in complex, fast-paced environments.
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communications skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority issues and tasks simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
Strong ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work proactively with a demonstrated ability to take initiative and resolve issues quickly and directly as they arise.
Clearance Required: Must have TS/SCI with Polygraph.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, FAC-P/PM Mid-Level, or Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) Level II certification in Program Management.
Experience applying Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies in support of program execution.
Demonstrated experience executing Earned Value Management (EVM) on a large, complex program.
At least five (5) years of experience supporting large-scale software development and hardware integration programs.
At least two (2) years of experience working in an Agile program environment.

Full-time

Description

Work Location:
Remote - U.S. Based. Candidates within driving distance of our Reston, VA office are preferred for occasional in-person meetings, but proximity to Reston is not required.

Duration:
Full Time

Travel:
Occasional travel for client requests and/or XTIVIA in-office meetings, up to 25%.

How You Will Make a Difference

XTIVIA is looking for an ERP Project Manager to lead client-facing ERP implementation projects from planning through delivery. In this role, you will manage project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and client expectations while working closely with functional and technical teams to keep multiple projects moving successfully.

You will serve as a key connection between our clients and internal teams, ensuring projects remain on track, issues are addressed proactively, and stakeholders have clear visibility throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery: Lead ERP projects using effective project management practices to achieve project goals on time and within budget while proactively identifying and managing risks.
Client Communication: Communicate project status, client readiness, business and technical issues, risks, decisions, and resolutions to clients, project teams, and management.
Budget & Resource Management: Monitor project budgets and funding expenditures while helping define, acquire, and allocate the staff and resources necessary to accomplish project objectives.
Financial Forecasting: Accurately forecast project labor hours and resource needs to support revenue planning and overall project performance.
Risk & Issue Management: Use project management, financial, and accounting tools to identify and assess project risks and coordinate issue tracking through resolution.
Project Documentation: Develop and maintain clear project documentation, diagrams, status reports, meeting materials, and other communications needed to support successful delivery.
Resource Coordination: Work closely with internal teams to ensure appropriate XTIVIA resources are available to support project needs and drive recommendations through implementation.
Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong client relationships throughout consulting engagements, with a focus on communication, trust, and client satisfaction.
Change Control: Coordinate client change control processes to effectively manage changes to project scope, timelines, resources, and expectations.
Project & Process Improvement: Contribute to project analysis and process improvement activities, identifying opportunities to strengthen project delivery and client outcomes.
Progress Reporting: Monitor and report on project progress while keeping stakeholders informed of milestones, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
Concurrent Project Management: Effectively manage multiple client projects and competing priorities at the same time.

Requirements

What you bring to your new team

A bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
2 to 5 years of experience working with ERP software as a consultant and/or Project Manager.
At least 1 year of experience in a client-facing project management role.
Experience supporting ERP implementation projects and managing activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities.
Strong customer relationship skills and experience working directly with clients.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate comfortably with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with functional, technical, and business teams.
Proficiency with G Suite and Microsoft Office, including Microsoft Project and Visio.
Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Salesforce, Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar systems.

How you add even MORE value

Experience managing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and/or Dynamics NAV implementation projects.
Experience supporting government contractors or GovCon ERP implementations, including familiarity with DCAA-compliant financial environments, project accounting, and contract types such as Time & Materials (T&M), cost-plus, and fixed price.
PMP, DASM, Agile/Scrum Master, or another relevant project management certification.
Experience working within an ERP consulting or professional services organization.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen. At this time, XTIVIA cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa for this position.

Get to know XTIVIA

XTIVIA is an innovative B2B technology enterprise solutions company committed to providing integrated technology solutions and services, delivering measurable results as a trusted industry thought leader for 30 years.

Our services include managed services and business solutions, like DevOps, CRM, and ITSM; database support and management; application solutions, including mobile apps; ERP solutions for GovCon and the private sector; and platform integration, with APIs as well as digital experience CMS solutions.

If you can imagine the business outcome, XTIVIA can create it with technology.

XTIVIA has offices in Colorado, New York, New Jersey, Texas, and Virginia.

xtivia.com

How we take care of our team members

For XTIVIA to recruit—and retain—the most experienced and talented people, XTIVIA offers a highly competitive and comprehensive benefits package. Our employees are our corporate family, so benefits extend beyond our employees to include their families. We provide affordable medical, dental, and vision benefits. Other benefits include a 401(k) plan with match, company-paid disability and life insurance, voluntary life insurance options, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), identity and fraud protection, recognition and wellness programs. To promote a healthy work-life balance, XTIVIA offers team members flexible paid time off and remote and flexible work options, enabling you to spend time with family and recharge as needed without worrying about accruals. In addition, we encourage ongoing career development by offering paid training and certification opportunities. Our benefits are designed and focused around our culture and core values, treating people the way we would like to be treated. XTIVIA has been certified four years in a row as a great place to work.

This position has an expected salary range of $75,000 - $100,000 annually.

You will also be eligible for the XTIVIA employee bonus plan.

Your compensation is based on your skills and experience -- talk with your recruiter to learn more.

jobs.title: Payments & Risk Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Cantina

Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future!

About The Role

Cantina.ai is building a commerce business—subscriptions, credits, and payments—and we're looking for the person who will own customer support for it.

You won't be doing this alone. Executives and teammates across Product, Engineering, and Operations are already invested in getting this right. Your job is to turn that shared focus into a support function that actually works, day to day.

Early on, that means rolling up your sleeves: working tickets yourself, building the first workflows, and getting a system in place fast. As volume grows, you'll shift toward setting direction, managing our vendor partners for billing and payments and overflow customer support capacity, and knowing which cases need Product, Engineering, or leadership rather than your own hands.

We think this is a great fit for someone 3-7 years into their career who's run support or support ops before, enjoys building something new alongside people who care about it, and wants real ownership over how it takes shape.

The role reports into Operations and works closely with the Product and Engineering teams behind subscriptions. It starts as an individual contributor role with high ownership; and as the business scales, you'll help decide whether and how the team grows with it.

What You'll Do

Own day-to-day customer support across eCommerce. Handle billing questions, cancellations, refunds, credit balance and top-up issues, failed or disputed payments, access issues, and general customer inquiries directly, especially early on while volume is low and workflows are still taking shape.
Own payments risk operations. Monitor fraud, refund abuse, disputes and chargeback patterns; investigate anomalous transaction and account behavior; develop policies and operational controls that balance loss prevention with a low-friction customer experience; and partner with Product, Engineering and our payment provider on improvements to authorization, fraud prevention and dispute performance.
Create and maintain the playbook. Build support workflows, macros, escalation paths, and SLAs across subscriptions, credits, and payments, working closely with the executives and teammates across Product, Engineering, and Operations who are also focused on getting this right.
Leverage and manage the payment platform relationship. Own billing operations with our payments platform day to day—disputes, chargebacks, failed payments, refund workflows, credit/balance adjustments, and reconciliation questions—coordinating with Finance as needed.
Leverage and manage the outsourced operations relationship. Serve as the primary point of contact with our outsourced operations team for surge/overflow support capacity, including onboarding their agents, maintaining documentation and macros they'll use, monitoring quality, and adjusting volume commitments as demand fluctuates.
Escalate effectively. Recognize which cases need to go beyond you—to Product or Engineering for a bug or root-cause fix, to Finance for a billing exception, or to leadership for a judgment call—and route them clearly rather than trying to resolve everything solo.
Partner with Product and Engineering. Surface recurring support themes, bugs, and friction points; represent the voice of the customer in roadmap conversations; validate fixes before they ship.
Track and report on support health. Own core support metrics (response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket volume/drivers by category, cost per ticket) and report on them regularly to Operations leadership.
Scale the model. As volume grows across subscriptions, credits, and payments, help determine when and how to bring on additional internal headcount vs. lean further on outsourced operations, and help build out whatever tooling (help desk platform, macros, self-serve/FAQ content) is needed to keep up.

What We're Looking For

3-7 years of experience in payments operations, payments risk, fraud operations, billing operations, or customer operations for a high-volume consumer product, with hands-on experience resolving complex customer cases.
Experience with payments risk, fraud operations, disputes/chargebacks, or transaction monitoring in a consumer subscription, marketplace, gaming, virtual currency/credits, or digital-goods business.
Direct, hands-on experience actually working support tickets—not just managing a team that does.
Experience working with a payments/billing platform (Stripe or similar strongly preferred) and comfort navigating billing edge cases like disputes, refunds, and failed payments.
Experience managing or coordinating with a BPO or outsourced support vendor (TaskUs or similar) through standard operational KPIs is a strong plus.
Comfort operating cross-functionally with Product and Engineering: you can translate ticket and account patterns into clear, prioritized, data-informed feedback they'll actually act on.
A builder's mindset – you're energized by implementing a process where none exists yet, and comfortable doing so alongside others across the company who are already invested in getting it right.
Strong written communication – you'll be writing macros, documentation, and escalation summaries that other people (including vendor agents) rely on.
Comfortable with ambiguity and change – this function will look different in six months than it does today, and you'll be the one shaping that evolution.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment with minimal structure or oversight – you will set priorities with your manager, but do not need a manager checking in daily to stay on track.

Bonus

Strong data skills - ability to utilize dashboards to track metrics and do basic investigations to spot and explore problems; ability to build or edit SQL queries (or willingness/ability to learn)
Using AI to scale - experience optimizing workflows and processes by building or utilizing AI agents

Schellman is a Top 50 CPA firm and a leading provider of attestation and compliance services. Our professional services focus on security and privacy audits, assessments, and certifications. Our specialty and expertise remain in providing best in class Cybersecurity and IT Audits and Attestations. Our culture, approach with clients, and dedication to our values has led us to consistently be a Great Places to Work certified company and rated as a Best Firms to Work For by Accounting Today and a Glassdoor Best Places to Work. We deeply appreciate our employees, as shown by our first core value – People Come First. This is demonstrated in our culture, benefits, and how we handle business. Come see what makes Schellman special!

Job Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for independently owning a portfolio of multiple, interconnected workstreams and ensuring they collectively deliver strategic value to the organization. This role manages interdependencies, risks, and resources across those workstreams, aligning outcomes with business objectives, and serves as the primary point of accountability for program-level status and decision-making. The Program Manager also owns change management planning and execution for assigned initiatives — assessing change impact, building the change management plan, and partnering with stakeholders across the firm to drive adoption. The Program Manager collaborates with stakeholders — including senior and executive leadership — to ensure transparency, governance, and successful execution of initiatives, and provides mentorship to Project Managers and Project Coordinators to help build project management capability across the PMO. This role does not have formal management authority over other Project Managers' workstreams but is expected to guide and mentor less senior team members informally. The Program Manager reports to the Manager of Enterprise PMO.

Essential Functions

Program Management:

Independently own and lead multiple interconnected workstreams or projects that roll up into a broader program, from initiation through close
Manage interdependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation across those workstreams
Facilitate stakeholder engagement and communication across business units, including regular exposure to senior and executive leadership
Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with scope, schedule, and budget across all workstreams
Provide regular reporting and insights to PMO leadership and executives on program-level status, risks, and outcomes
Serve as an informal mentor to Project Managers and Project Coordinators, sharing PMO methodology, tools, and best practices
Ensure compliance with PMO standards and contribute to methodology and process improvements
Champion the advancement of the PMO by bringing forward best practices in project and program management from across the industry
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting that give leadership clear, timely visibility into program and portfolio health
Serve as a subject matter expert in program management tools and platforms, driving effective adoption and use across the PMO

Change Management

Assess the change management needs of each assigned initiative based on audience (directly and indirectly impacted) and the size, scope, and complexity of the planned change
Create a comprehensive change management plan (CMP), consistent with and aligned to the broader Schellman strategy, to include:
Communications needs and activities
Training needs
Ongoing support and documentation needs
Timeline, budget, and measurable success criteria

Partner with stakeholders and functional resources across the firm to execute the change management plan and drive adoption

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong program and portfolio management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, interdependent workstreams
Ability to manage complexity and cross-functional coordination without direct authority over contributing team members
Demonstrated ability to build and execute change management plans, including communications, training, and adoption measurement
Ability to partner cross-functionally across the firm to drive adoption of change initiatives
Skilled in building dashboards and reporting, with strong working expertise in program/project management tools and platforms
Experience managing IT-related projects and demonstrated ability to select and blend project management approaches (waterfall, agile, hybrid) based on workstream needs
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities, including comfort presenting to senior and executive leadership
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced project management staff
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Wrike and JIRA or other project management software

Education, Work Experience And Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent years of directly related experience
7+ years of project/program management experience, including demonstrated experience managing multiple interconnected or large-scale initiatives concurrently
Experience building and leading change management plans (communications, training, adoption) for enterprise initiatives
Experience mentoring or informally guiding other project management staff
Experience working on IT-related projects, applying both waterfall and agile/hybrid delivery approaches
PMP or PgMP certification preferred

new_jobs.description:
Brief Description

As a Marketing Project Delivery Manager at Tricel, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering a diverse portfolio of marketing projects, with a particular focus on the connection between marketing and development processes. You will ensure that all marketing initiatives are delivered efficiently, on time, and within budget, while demonstrating a strong understanding of development methodologies and technologies. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong marketing channel expertise, CRM knowledge, and project management skills to deliver best-in-class marketing programmes across the full marketing mix. You will be experienced in online conversion and will actively run optimisation initiatives to ensure benchmark-level performance across all channels. You will act as the owner of all digital project execution related to design and development, continuously improving processes to ensure delivery takes place in a lean and optimised environment. The Project Manager will be responsible for leading a team that supports the department with the setup, installation, and management of marketing technology tools and products. They will work with stakeholders and end users to plan and configure systems, developing solutions that achieve the required objectives. They will oversee the deployment of programmes and systems, coordinating all parties involved to ensure a smooth process with minimal disruption. The successful candidate must be comfortable working in an agency-style environment where resources need to be managed effectively. The Marketing Project Delivery Manager will report directly to the Group Head of Marketing.

Responsibilities

Manage the day-to-day workload of the design and development team, covering activities from minor updates to Tier 1 project rollouts.
Manage the end-to-end delivery of digital projects and associated technology infrastructure, including marketing automation and CRM integration.
Work closely with technical teams to understand development constraints and opportunities, ensuring marketing initiatives are technically feasible.
Take ownership of both your own platforms and the wider digital platform, safeguarding their reputation within the business and across customer groups.
Act as the primary point of contact for counterpart marketing executives, leading future initiative pipeline readiness, resource planning, capacity estimation, and associated budgeting.
Manage dependencies and interfaces between projects, channels, and platforms, as well as risks and issues that may affect team success, ensuring resources are used appropriately, stakeholders are kept informed, and the consequences of actions are clearly understood.
Provide comprehensive reports on project performance, timelines, and budget.
Analyse project outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement in future projects.
Manage marketing standard operating procedures, including creating new SOPs, maintaining and updating existing procedures, and ensuring the marketing team remains aligned with approved SOPs.
Onboard new Tricel Group team members to the CRM and wider marketing technology stack, ensuring they understand the relevant tools, processes, and best-practice ways of working.
Lead cross-disciplinary programmes aimed at improving conversion across all channels used in the marketing mix, with particular emphasis on websites and other digital media.
Lead daily team stand-ups, track risks, and help eliminate blockers.
Build and maintain a motivated delivery team, including third-party development resources, ensuring there is an iterative plan to work towards.
Drive the digital team to work at pace, ensuring the team remains focused on delivery commitments.
Ensure the team collaborates effectively, communicates clearly, and focuses on the highest-priority work.
Coach team members and colleagues, facilitate continuous improvement, and apply the most appropriate agile and lean tools and techniques for the environment.

Candidate Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
3 - 5 years’ experience in project management, with a strong understanding of both marketing and development processes.
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
Proficient in project management tools and software; JIRA experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously in an agency-style setup.
Ability to identify opportunities to deliver an excellent customer experience through project delivery.
Knowledge of computer operating systems, hardware, and software.
Strong analytical thinking skills.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent qualification.
Experience in digital marketing or creative project management.
Familiarity with the latest marketing trends and technologies.
Expertise in CRM management; HubSpot experience is preferred but not mandatory.
Experience working in a cross-functional role involving marketing and software development.
Technical understanding of web development concepts.

What do we offer?

At Tricel, we care about your development and progression. Alongside a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer:

Excellent development and growth opportunities
A supportive and collaborative culture
A fun and dynamic work environment
Team-oriented atmosphere.
Good work-life balance.
Opportunity to work across countries and cultures
Employee Assistance Programme
Tax-free vouchers to the value of €1,500
Sports and Social Club.
Health and Wellbeing initiatives
Enhanced maternity leave.
Health Insurance Contribution

About Tricel

Tricel, a family-run business, was founded in 1973 by Anne Stack and Con Stack. The company began by producing products from glass-reinforced plastics (GRP) and expanded its exports and manufacturing facilities across the UK and Europe through a comprehensive growth strategy in the 1990s and 2000s. The Stack family continues to lead Tricel, which provides market-leading solutions in more than 50 countries. The company serves markets including storage tanks, pumps, sewage treatment tanks, construction products, and lubricant distribution. Headquartered in Killarney, the Tricel Group consists of 19 companies across Europe, including seven manufacturing facilities, and employs more than 600 people across these locations. The company has grown domestically and internationally by manufacturing locally, exporting, partnering with local distributors, and acquiring companies that strengthen its product capabilities and geographical reach. Over the next five years, the company’s roadmap for growth will continue to be based on three main pillars: Customer Excellence, Innovation, and Sustainability.

If you are interested in applying for this exciting opportunity, please email HR@tricel.ie with your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you. Closing date for applications is 5pm, Monday 24th August 2026.

构建数据驱动的智能决策体系
您将建立并利用项目数据仪表板与AI分析工具，实时监控开发效能、质量指标、资源负荷与风险信号。通过预测性分析（如基于历史数据的延期风险预测、价值流瓶颈识别），实现从被动响应到主动干预的管理升级。
设计并运营自适应交付框架
针对AI项目特性（如数据依赖、模型迭代、算力管理），您将为客户量身定制或优化混合交付框架（如敏捷、流式框架与阶段门控的结合）。
您将引入并实践AI辅助的项目管理实践，例如利用自然语言处理自动生成用户故事、通过模拟优化资源调度、或使用智能工具管理技术债务与依赖关系。
管理智能化解决方案的价值闭环
您将确保项目目标与客户的AI战略及业务价值紧密对齐。这包括共同定义合理的成功度量标准（如模型准确率、用户采纳度、业务指标提升），并建立从模型性能监控到业务影响分析的持续反馈循环，证明技术投资的回报。
驾驭技术风险与伦理治理

赋能团队与生态化协作

您将营造一个心理安全、持续学习的团队环境，特别鼓励在探索性技术工作中进行知识分享与复盘。作为关键枢纽，您将有效整合客户、内部专家及第三方技术供应商，构建高效协同的交付生态。

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior
Project Manager
to support our multi-disciplinary design team addressing the most challenging engineering tasks in power generation. AECOM's broad technical capabilities, global footprint and experience in executing large scale projects uniquely position us to lead in renewable, traditional steam, thermal power generation and advanced nuclear technologies.

This includes being a part of the first-of-a-kind program with AECOM partners advancing the innovative stellarator technology to the world.

https://aecom.com/press-releases/aecom-establishes-partnership-with-type-one-energy-to-provide-design-engineering-services-for-its-innovative-stellarator-fusion-power-plant-infinity-two/

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Energy offices located in multiple locations across the United States.

We seek a project professional able to manage the project lifecycle from the project basis of design stage through the issuance of deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination between internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a strong understanding of engineering design, interconnection, utility markets, and construction processes. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, as well as the ability to lead matrixed design teams and manage client-approved engineering consultants.

The successful candidate will:

Responsible for the management of assigned projects; Function as the project manager / program manager
Take ownership of internal project financials, staffing, legal coordination, and risk management.
Facilitate planning and kickoff meetings to ensure alignment among all project stakeholders.
Support projects through complete life cycle including the feasibility phase, preliminary and detailed design, issue-for-bid, construction, start-up, and commissioning
Facilitate the design process, including conducting "page-turn design reviews" and equipment fabrication reviews at key project milestones (30%, 60%, and 100% design completion).
Work closely with the technical delivery team (incl subcontractors) to confirm deliverables and services are being provided to exceed client’s satisfaction. This includes coordination with team members across the world
Deliver projects in accordance with the AECOM Quality Management System (QMS) process
Proposal support / capture leadership to support business development activities
Identify project opportunities early and facilitate go/no-go decisions, determine project fees, write proposals, prepare and lead client presentations, and negotiation of contracts
Client development through existing contracts/relationships including managing key accounts and developing new accounts
Occasional travel to client or project sites

Level specific responsibilities:

Responsible for the overall management administration to project and assists in establishing project specific objectives and policies.
Provides management and guidance to subordinate managers, enforces company and project policies, and a primary liaison between AECOM and client interface.
Oversees and ensures all facets of the project are delivered in accordance with design, budget and schedule through subordinate managers and supervisors.
Responsible for administering the project from budgeting/schedule stage through procurement and contract closeout. Position has significant profit/loss responsibility for assigned project.

AECOM’s Energy practice provides a wide range of services from consulting and engineering design to energy engineering, energy procurement and construction (EPC) for power, energy efficiency, and renewable energy clients. Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

BA/BS in Electrical, Mechanical Engineering or related degree and 6 years of relevant project management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
Project Management experience directly related to power generation projects
Demonstrated experience delivering complex engineering projects and/or programs

Preferred Qualifications:

Project Management Professional (PMP)
Professional Engineering Licensure (PE)
Nuclear project experience
+15 Years of relevant experience, power generation or heavy industrial
Experience in managing projects worked in collaborative model environments (e.g. Navisworks, BIM/ACC)
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to effectively manage diverse teams and stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage large-scale, complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated success working in a remote team environment

Additional Information

Relocation assistance may be available for this position

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $140000 to $180000.

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_jobs.description:
Role Description

Technical Program Manager

Project Manager II

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) with strong software development program experience to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, and client stakeholders.

The Opportunity

Lead and execute cross-functional software development programs spanning engineering, product management, QA, DevOps, and operations teams.
Own program schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and executive-level reporting.
Translate business and product requirements into clear technical execution plans.
Drive program execution across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
Coordinate delivery across backend services, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and cloud-based systems.
Facilitate Agile program-level ceremonies including PI planning, release planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Identify and proactively mitigate technical, execution, and dependency risks.
Manage cross-team and cross-geo dependencies to ensure alignment and accountability.
Track and communicate program health using metrics related to schedule, quality, scope, and resource utilization.
Support client interactions, executive reviews, and stakeholder communications.
Drive change management, scope trade-offs, and prioritization decisions to meet delivery commitments.
Partner with engineering leadership to align on architecture, design decisions, and technical dependencies.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need

8+ years of experience managing software development programs or technical project delivery.
Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud-based applications.
Hands-on experience managing programs involving:
Backend systems and microservices
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Enterprise or large-scale software applications
Deep understanding of Agile / Scrum / SAFe methodologies.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional and client-facing programs.
Strong program management, execution discipline, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to drive risk management, technical triage, and data-driven decision-making.
Desired Skills:
Prior experience as a Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Architect.
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and production operations.
Experience working in client delivery or matrixed environments.
Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar tools.
PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Agile certifications (preferred but optional).
Qualification:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Compensation can differ depending on factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, education, and level of experience. UST provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in various U.S. markets as set forth below.

Role Location: Redmond, Washington

Compensation Range
:
$102,000-$153,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

What We Believe

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.
